component.name: Linux EPUB Reader
component.summary: Read EPUBs and play offline audiobooks and music

description.p: A local EPUB reader with chapter scrolling, contents, search, bookmarks, saved positions and a Home dashboard showing recent books, M4B audiobooks and music with locally embedded artwork and metadata.

Play DRM-free M4B audiobooks or local music and playlists with a separate player, Linux desktop media-key controls and optional Cinnamon lock-screen controls. Mounted removable drives are available read-only in the Flatpak.
The app uses Atkinson Hyperlegible with a dark reading surface. It works locally and does not need network access to read books.
This is not a browser-grade EPUB renderer. Complex publisher layouts, illustrations, embedded media, and Adobe DRM are not supported.
